scope: Competition business nodes, actual SDK reuse, infrastructure coupling and current delivery priorities; not an exhaustive correctness audit.
decision: Freeze research extensions and general infrastructure growth; retain the current runtime and necessary guards. Limit remaining preparation to existing CLI acceptance and final localization/business-check readiness. No real-effect or paper-contribution claim.

findings.evidence: agent.py excludes default filesystem actions, summarization and delegation; create_deep_agent, message/tool loop, SQLite checkpoint and SkillsMiddleware are actually reused.
findings.action: Correct documentation that claimed default SDK file/context reuse; do not migrate the stack or expand custom general tooling.

findings.evidence: Root-cause strategy, obligations, full static Skills and working-context payloads enter the loop; decision next_action remains advisory and runtime probe budget is zero. The reviewed historical demo scripts the model actions, consumes one Skill and no ordinary retrieval/applicability actions.
findings.action: Judge actual root selection, behavior preservation and feedback changes with independent checks and paired real runs when authorized; schema/source tests do not certify efficacy.

findings.evidence: reporting.py _localization permits empty root locations and merges hypotheses; competition.py _report checks candidate-linked diagnosis object truthiness rather than concrete selected root lines.
findings.action: Narrow follow-up fix: distinguish final localization completeness and selected/alternative locations from application-check facts; continue allowing intermediate unknown diagnoses. No causal correctness claim from nonempty lines.

findings.evidence: LocalCheckConfig validates declared oracle hash shape; full project manifest indirectly fixes in-project scripts, but the declared field is not verified against oracle content. Existing design already states this boundary.
findings.action: Prepare actual independent expected behavior and crash-disappeared-but-business-wrong counterexamples for two representative cases; do not build another provenance system.

findings.evidence: Four static Skills use general knowledge registry/snapshot/index/report auditing. Disabled method switches retain common pipeline for ablation. Full src fingerprint binds deferred modules to resume compatibility. Competition does not execute the full automatic promotion pipeline.
findings.action: Freeze promotion, full version/deployment closure, lifecycle research costs and automatic capture; preserve prior contracts and failures. Keep existing budget, unknown-result, candidate/check and local resource guards.

observability_direction: Prefer locked LangGraph streaming/callback and standard logs; optional official LangSmith or Langfuse adapter after compatibility and private-data boundary review. No new tracing deployment prerequisite and no integration performed.
